Hero Vida V1 Pro Electric Scooter: A Detailed Review:

The Hero Vida V1 Pro is Hero MotoCorp’s premium offering in the electric scooter segment. With a price of ₹1,49,900 (ex-showroom), the Vida V1 Pro is positioned as a high-end option for those seeking a blend of performance, features, and sustainability.

Hero Vida V1 Pro Specifications:

The Vida V1 Pro is equipped with a 3.94 kWh lithium-ion battery that is powered by a PMSM (permanent magnet synchronous) motor that can generate 6kw peak power. This setup delivers a top speed of 80 km/h and an impressive range of 165 km on a single charge, making it one of the most capable scooters in terms of mileage efficiency.

Range and Mileage:

The Hero Vida V1 Pro range is a standout feature, with the scooter capable of covering up to 165 km on a single charge, ensuring riders can enjoy extended travel without the need for frequent recharging. The mileage efficiency of the Vida V1 Pro makes it an ideal choice for both daily commutes and longer urban rides.

Features of Hero Vida V1 Pro:

The Vida V1 Pro comes packed with features that enhance the user experience. It includes a 7-inch TFT touchscreen, customizable ride modes, cruise control, two-way throttle, keyless control, smartphone connectivity, geo-fencing, OTA updates, regenerative braking, reverse mode, and an S.O.S. switch.

Colors and Design:

The Hero Vida V1 Pro is available in a range of colors, including Matte Pearl White, Matte Sports Red, Matte Abrax Orange, Matte Cyan, and Black, allowing riders to choose a scooter that best fits their style.

Battery Price and Warranty:

The Hero Vida V1 Pro battery price is included in the overall cost of the scooter, and customers can opt for an extended battery warranty for a total of 5 years and 60,000 km at ₹6,999+ GST. 

Customer Feedback:

Customer feedback on the Hero Vida V1 Pro has been largely positive, with many praising its performance, range, and feature set.

Comparison with Competitors:

The Hero Vida V1 Pro competes with other electric scooters such as the Ola S1 Pro, Ather 450X, and Bajaj Chetak. It stands out for its superior range and comprehensive feature set but is also one of the priciest options in its segment.

Pros:

  • Enjoyable family scooter riding experience.
  • Dual removable batteries for extended range.
  • Access to official fast charging stations and Ather grid support.
  • Advanced smart features with ample storage space.

Cons:

  • The app has too many bugs.
  • Water seeps under the seat during heavy rain.

Experts Conclusion:

The Hero Vida V1 Pro electric scooter is a compelling option for those looking for a reliable, feature-rich, and efficient mode of transportation. With its competitive price, impressive range, and array of features, the Vida V1 Pro stands as a strong contender in the electric scooter segment.

Hero Vida V1 Plus Electric Scooter: Detailed Review

The Hero Vida V1 Plus is a significant addition to the electric scooter market, offering a sustainable and efficient mode of transportation. With an ex-showroom price of ₹1.15 lakh, which can be further reduced by state subsidies, the Vida V1 Plus is competitively priced for its segment.

Specifications and Performance

The Vida V1 Plus is powered by a 3.44 kWh lithium-ion battery pack that supports a top speed of 80 km/h and provides a range of 143 km on a full charge. It can accelerate from 0-40 km/h in just 3.4 seconds and offers three riding modes – Eco, Ride, and Sport, catering to different riding preferences.

Features and Design

The Vida V1 Plus comes with a host of features including a 7-inch TFT touchscreen, customizable ride modes, cruise control, two-way throttle, keyless control, smartphone connectivity, geo-fencing, OTA updates, regenerative braking, reverse mode, and an S.O.S. switch. It is available in 5 colours: Mat Pearl White, Mat Sports Red, Mat Abrax Orange, Mat Cyan, and Black, allowing riders to choose a scooter that best fits their style.

Battery Price and Warranty

The battery price for the Vida V1 Plus is included in the overall cost of the scooter, and customers can opt for an extended battery warranty for a total of 5 years and 60,000 km at ₹6,999+ GST.

Customer Feedback

Customers have praised the Vida V1 Plus for its smooth ride quality, ample storage space, and user-friendly features. However, some have expressed a desire for improvements in areas such as the charging infrastructure and service support.

Comparison with Competitors

The Vida V1 Plus competes with other electric scooters such as the Ather 450S, Ola S1 Air, TVS iQube, and the Bajaj Chetak Urbane. It stands out for its superior range and comprehensive feature set but is also one of the priciest options in its segment.

Pros:

  • Enjoyable family scooter riding experience.
  • Dual removable batteries for extended range.
  • Access to official fast charging stations and Ather grid support.
  • Advanced smart features with ample storage space.

Cons:

  • The app has too many bugs.
  • Water seeps under the seat during heavy rain.

Expert Conclusion:

The Hero Vida V1 Plus electric scooter is a compelling option for those looking for a reliable, feature-rich, and efficient mode of transportation. With its competitive price, impressive range, and array of features, the Vida V1 Plus stands as a strong contender in the electric scooter segment.
